CENTRAL
September 24 1923

REPORT ON Dr. M. de Golbert, a Russian of Bolshevik Sympathies

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Inspector of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

Dr. M. de Golbert, whose real name is believed
to be Mordecai Goldberg, arrived in Shanghai about 1921
from Russia where, it is stated, he had incurred the displeasure
of the Bolsheviks on account of his activities as an
Anarchist.

Notwithstanding the alleged differences with
Soviet officials, de Golbert soon after his arrival here
began to make strenuous efforts to propagate Bolshevism
among Koreans and Chinese whose friendship he took pains to
cultivate. It is also alleged that he was on friendly terms
with some Indians, and was interested in plans for supplying
revolutionaries in that country with arms. He also endeavoured
to promote a scheme for the purchase of a tract of land in
Australia which would be worked on co-operative lines by
Russian refugees from Shanghai.

Accompanied by his wife, three children, a friend
named Finkelgold and two others who were alleged to be anarchists
de Golbert left Shanghai on April 22, 1922, for Canton where
he was arrested in the middle of October of the same year
for being concerned in a bomb outrage directed against Chen
Chun Ming (陳炯明). After the latter's overthrow and
flight from Canton, de Golbert was exonerated by the Canton
District Court and released on January 17, 1923. He then
continued to reside in Canton from that date until last August
when he proceeded to Yinkow, Newchwang, accompanied again by
his wife and family, one John Schlosser, who claims to be an

关于具有布尔什维克倾向的俄国人 M. de Golbert 博士的报告

由 D. I. Givens 撰写，经刑事情报督察转呈。

先生，

M. de Golbert 博士，据信其真名为 Mordecai Goldberg，约于1921年从俄国抵达上海。据说，他因从事无政府主义活动而招致布尔什维克的不满。

尽管据称与苏维埃官员存在分歧，de Golbert 抵沪后不久便开始竭力在朝鲜人和中国人中宣传布尔什维主义，并费心与他们建立友谊。另据称，他与一些印度人关系友好，并对向该国革命者提供武器的计划感兴趣。他还试图推动一项在澳大利亚购买一块土地的计划，该土地将由来自上海的俄国难民以合作方式经营。

1922年4月22日，de Golbert 在其妻子、三个孩子、一位名叫 Finkelgold 的朋友以及两名据称为无政府主义者的陪同下离开上海前往广州。同年10月中旬，他因涉嫌参与针对陈炯明的炸弹袭击案而在广州被捕。在陈炯明倒台并逃离广州后，de Golbert 被广州地方法院宣告无罪，并于1923年1月17日获释。随后，他从该日起至去年8月一直居住在广州，之后再次由其妻子和家属陪同，前往营口（牛庄），同行者中还有一位自称是美国人的 John Schlosser，以及

American, and Four Chinese whose names were Dung Zeh Sung
(鄧日勝), Lu Tsz Yuin(韓子雲), Zung Hwei(陳煥),
and Ling Poh Tsai(凌伯燦), The party arrived in Shanghai
by the s.s. "Lushan Maru" on the morning of August 20
and left by the s.s. "Shaoxing" two days later.
There is good reason to believe that de
Colbert was once employed in the radical section of the Canton
Army by Dr. Sun Yat Sen, and it has been suggested that he is
still in the latter's service. De Colbert, who belongs
to the Jewish religion, is supposed to be an expert in the
use of explosives.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. McLeans
D. I.

D. C. I.

四名中国人，姓名分别为 Dung Zeh Sung (鄧日勝)、Lu Tsz Yuin (韓子雲)、Zung Hwei (陳煥) 和 Ling Poh Tsai (凌伯燦)。该团伙于8月20日上午乘“庐山丸”轮（s.s. "Lushan Maru"）抵达上海，两天后乘“绍兴”轮（s.s. "Shaoxing"）离开。
有充分理由相信，de Colbert 曾受孙中山博士雇佣，在广州军队的激进部门任职，且有说法称他目前仍为其效力。De Colbert 信奉犹太教，据信是使用炸药的专家。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
J. McLeans

Dear Mr McEuen,

I expect that the enclosed information has already reached
you but I thought it might be worth while passing on. I have only just
received it.

CONFIDENTIAL. Bolshevists

The S.S. "Lushan Maru" left Hongkong for Shanghai on the
15th August.

She carries as third class passengers the following persons
who had come from Canton:-

Doctor Colbert, wife and three children.
Jans Schlosser, carrying American papers, but no passport.
They were accompanied by two Chinese. Police are informed
that Colbert's destination is Tientsin, and that his mission is to remove
Wu Pei Fu. Colbert is a well-known anarchist in Canton, and is known to
be a tool of Sun. He specialises in bombs and assassination.

Ria Rennie

“庐山丸”轮（S.S. "Lushan Maru"）于8月15日离开香港前往上海。

该船载有以下从广州前来的三等舱乘客：

Colbert 医生、妻子及三个孩子。
Jans Schlosser，持有美国证件，但无护照。

I.O. 4423

THE SHANGHAI GAZETTE, SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 1922.

THE CANTON SUSPECT
Dr. M.M. de Colbert, the German held by the Canton authorities in connection with the bomb outrages on October 19, is still refused bail, says the Canton Times.
The nationality of Dr. de Colbert has not yet been determined. He was born in Canada, it is said, but is holding American and German passports. He may be adjudged a British subject, after all.
So far no action has been taken in connection with the disposal of the case, as his nationality has not yet been formally determined and he cannot be turned over to any local foreign consulate. He may be released soon and ordered out of Canton, many thinking this will be the easiest way to dispose of the case.
Dr. Ching Yick-lap, a woman physician and dean of the Republic Hospital, under whom Dr. de Colbert is serving as a resident physician, has been practically exonerated from the case. She was also a suspect for a time.
pages.zh:
I.O. 4423

《上海公报》，1922年11月4日，星期六。

广州嫌疑犯
《广州时报》称，德国人 M.M. de Colbert 博士因涉及10月19日的炸弹袭击案被广州当局拘留，目前仍被拒绝保释。
De Colbert 博士的国籍尚未确定。据说他出生于加拿大，但持有美国和德国护照。他最终可能被判定为英国臣民。
截至目前，此案的处理尚未采取任何行动，因为其国籍尚未正式确定，且无法将其移交给任何当地外国领事馆。许多人认为，将他释放并勒令离开广州将是处理此案最简便的方式，因此他可能很快获释。
郑益立（Ching Yick-lap）博士是一位女医生，也是共和医院（Republic Hospital）的院长，De Colbert 博士在她手下担任住院医师，她在此案中已基本被免除嫌疑。她也曾一度成为嫌疑人。

september 24,

My dear Barton,

With reference to your enquiry
regarding Dr. L. de Colbert, this man, whose
real name is believed to be Lordecai Goldberg,
arrived in Shanghai about 1921 from Russia where,
it is stated, he had incurred the displeasure of
the Bolsheviks on account of his activities as an
American agent. Notwithstanding the alleged
differences with Soviet officials, de Colbert
after his arrival here began to make strenuous
efforts to propagate Bolshevism among Koreans and
Chinese whose friendship he took pains to cultivate.
It is also alleged that he was on friendly terms
with some Indians, and was interested in plans for
supplying revolutionaries in that country with arms.
He also endeavoured to promote a scheme for the
purchase of a tract of land in Australia which would
be worked on co-operative lines by Russian refugees
from Shanghai. Accompanied by his wife, three
children, a friend named Finkelstein and two others
who were alleged to be anarchists, de Colbert left
Shanghai on April ..., 1922 for Canton where he was
arrested in the middle of October of the same year
for being concerned in a bomb outrage directed against
Chen Chuin-ring ( ). After the latter's overthrow
and flight from Canton, de Colbert was exonerated by
the Canton District Court and released on January 17,
1923. He continued to reside in Canton from that date

9月24日，

亲爱的 Barton：

关于您询问的 L. de Colbert 博士一事，此人据信真名为 Lordecai Goldberg，约于1921年从俄国抵达上海。据说，他因作为美国特工的活动而招致布尔什维克的不满。尽管据称与苏维埃官员存在分歧，de Colbert 抵沪后便开始竭力在朝鲜人和中国人中宣传布尔什维主义，并费心与他们建立友谊。另据称，他与一些印度人关系友好，并对向该国革命者提供武器的计划感兴趣。他还试图推动一项在澳大利亚购买一块土地的计划，该土地将由来自上海的俄国难民以合作方式经营。1922年4月...日，de Colbert 在其妻子、三个孩子、一位名叫 Finkelstein 的朋友以及两名据称为无政府主义者的陪同下离开上海前往广州。同年10月中旬，他因涉嫌参与针对 Chen Chuin-ring ( ) 的炸弹袭击案而在广州被捕。在后者倒台并逃离广州后，de Colbert 被广州地方法院宣告无罪，并于1923年1月17日获释。从该日起，他继续居住在广州，直到

pages.en:
2.

until August 1st when he proceeded to Yinkow,
Newchwang, accompanied again by his wife and
family, one John Schlosser, who claims to be an
American , and four Chinese whose names are
Dung Suk-sung (        ), Bu Tsz-yu (        ),
Zung Hwei (        ) and Ling Pei-tsai (        ).
The party arrived in Shanghai by the s.s.
"Lusitania" on the morning of August 20 and
left by the s.s. "Sinoaking" two days later.
There is good reason to believe that de
Colbert was once employed in the radical section
of the Canton Army by Sun Yat-sen , and it has been
suggested that he is still in the latter's service.
De Colbert, who belongs to the Jewish religion, is
supposed to be an expert in the use of explosives.

Yours sincerely,

F. Barton, Esquire, C.M.G.,
H. B. M.'s Consul-General,
Shanghai.

于同年十月中旬因卷入针对陈炯明（Chen Chun-ming）的炸弹袭击案而被捕。在陈炯明倒台并逃离广州后，德·科尔伯特被广州地方法院宣告无罪，并于1928年1月17日获释。（注：此处原文年份“1928”与前文“1922-1923”语境似有矛盾，但依要求照实译出）。自该日起至去年八月，他一直居住在广州，随后在其妻子和家属、一名自称是美国人的约翰·施洛瑟（John Schlosser）以及四名华人——邓亚松（Deng Yah-sung，或子民 Tze-min）、冯阿奇（Fung A-chi）和凌柏泰（Ling Pak-tai）——的再次陪同下，前往营口（Newchwang）的牛庄（Yirkow，音译，通常指营口旧称或附近地区）。一行人于8月20日上午乘“岩田丸”号（s.s. "Iwata Maru"）抵达上海，两天后乘“绍兴”号（s.s. "Shochine"，音译）离开。有充分理由相信，德·科尔伯特曾受雇于孙中山麾下的广东军队医疗部门，且有说法称他目前仍为其效力。德·科尔伯特信奉犹太教，据推测是爆炸物使用方面的专家。

此致

敬礼

R. G. A. 普伦尼克（Plunnicke）上尉
英国海军代理机构
扬子保险公司大楼

FROM NAVAL GENERAL STAFF OFFICER
TELEPHONE No. 3078.
TELEGRAMS: "NAVALITE SHANGHAI."

9. O. 4423
H. M. NAVAL AGENCY, 12/10/23
YANGTSZE INSURANCE BUILDING,
SHANGHAI.
（印：整）
10th October 1923.

Dear Mr. McEuen,

The following information concerning Dr. M. Colbert
was received by me from a Naval Officer who lived near him in Canton and
used to go to tea with the family and knew them fairly well.

"Description:- Small, fat, red beard and moustache, 50 years old.
Wife:- Fat and dark.
Children:- One girl with very red hair and one girl and one
boy with black hair.

"When in Canton he posed as American, Belgian and Russian. He is
actually a German. The small boy let this out one day by accident in
course of conversation. The German Consul in Canton knows he is German.
He is supposed to have left Germany with Trotsky and Lenin in the
sealed train which took them to Russia at the time of the revolution.
Later on he is supposed to have fallen out with them and gone off on his own
He is not a real Bolshey agent as far as any recognition from the
Soviet is concerned. He is not controlled by Russia or any other
country but is without doubt a fanatical anarchist.
He took the trouble to hide the fact that he was a German."

The remainder of the information was exactly the same as in the
docket you sent me.

Yours sincerely,
R A Rennie

来自海军参谋部军官
电话第3078号
电报挂号：“NAVALITE SHANGHAI”

9. O. 4423
英国海军代理机构，23年10月12日
扬子保险公司大楼，
上海。
（印：整）
1923年10月10日。

亲爱的麦克尤恩（McEuen）先生：

以下关于M. 科尔伯特博士的信息是我从一位曾在广州与他毗邻而居的海军军官那里获得的，该军官常去其家中喝茶，对他们相当了解。

“外貌描述：身材矮小，肥胖，红胡须和红胡子，50岁。
妻子：肥胖，肤色黝黑。
子女：一个头发非常红的女孩，以及一个黑发女孩和一个黑发男孩。

“在广州期间，他伪装成美国人、比利时人和俄国人。他实际上是德国人。这个小男孩有一天在谈话中偶然泄露了这一点。驻广州的德国领事知道他是德国人。据说，在革命时期，他与托洛茨基和列宁一起乘坐将他们送往俄国的密封列车离开了德国。后来，据说他与他们闹翻，便独自行动。就苏联方面的认可而言，他并非真正的布尔什维克代理人。他不受俄国或任何其他国家的控制，但无疑是一名狂热的无政府主义者。他不惜费力地隐瞒自己是德国人的事实。”

其余信息与你寄给我的卷宗内容完全一致。

此致

敬礼

R. A. 伦尼（Rennie）
